'''Bloodworthy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who won a hunt which happened during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Thus, he was proclaimed a [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] and had access to the [[Blacklist]]. He was [[Grand Champions massacre|killed]] alongside the other Champions by a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]'s team.
